package com.acme.rules;

/**
 * The {@code fees} decision table (hit policy COLLECT, SUM).
 *
 * <p>Rules are read once from {@code Fees.dmn} on the classpath, written by
 * praecepta-maven-plugin from {@code fees.csv} and validated at build time.
 * Instances are not needed: all methods are static and thread-safe.
 */
public final class Fees {

    /** The DMN resource, relative to this class. */
    public static final String RESOURCE = "Fees.dmn";

    private static final io.github.brunopacheco1.praecepta.engine.PraeceptaEngine<FeesInput, FeesOutput> ENGINE = build();

    private Fees() {
    }

    /**
     * @return the sum of the matching rules' outputs, or empty if no rule matches
     * @throws io.github.brunopacheco1.praecepta.engine.exceptions.HitPolicyViolationException if the hit policy is violated
     * @throws io.github.brunopacheco1.praecepta.engine.exceptions.InvalidInputException if a value is outside its column's value list
     */
    public static java.util.Optional<FeesOutput> evaluate(FeesInput input) {
        var outputs = ENGINE.evaluate(input);
        return outputs.isEmpty() ? java.util.Optional.empty() : java.util.Optional.of(outputs.getFirst());
    }

    /** The underlying engine, e.g. to pass around as a function. */
    public static io.github.brunopacheco1.praecepta.engine.PraeceptaEngine<FeesInput, FeesOutput> engine() {
        return ENGINE;
    }

    /** Findings of the static analysis (overlaps, unreachable rules, gaps). */
    public static io.github.brunopacheco1.praecepta.engine.ValidationReport validationReport() {
        return ENGINE.validationReport();
    }

    private static io.github.brunopacheco1.praecepta.engine.PraeceptaEngine<FeesInput, FeesOutput> build() {
        try (var dmn = Fees.class.getResourceAsStream(RESOURCE)) {
            if (dmn == null) {
                throw new IllegalStateException("Missing resource " + RESOURCE + " next to " + Fees.class.getName());
            }
            return io.github.brunopacheco1.praecepta.engine.PraeceptaEngine.<FeesInput, FeesOutput>builder()
                    .table(io.github.brunopacheco1.praecepta.engine.dmn.DmnReader.read(dmn))
                    .enumInput("zone", FeesInput.Zone.class, FeesInput.Zone::value, FeesInput::zone)
                    .output(new io.github.brunopacheco1.praecepta.engine.OutputStrategy<FeesOutput>() {
                        @Override
                        public FeesOutput transform(io.github.brunopacheco1.praecepta.engine.beans.PraeceptaOutput output) {
                            return FeesOutput.of(output);
                        }

                        @Override
                        public FeesOutput sum(FeesOutput a, FeesOutput b) {
                            return a.fee() == null ? b : b.fee() == null ? a
                                    : new FeesOutput(a.fee().add(b.fee(), java.math.MathContext.DECIMAL128));
                        }

                        @Override
                        public FeesOutput min(FeesOutput a, FeesOutput b) {
                            return a.fee() == null ? b : b.fee() == null || a.fee().compareTo(b.fee()) <= 0 ? a : b;
                        }

                        @Override
                        public FeesOutput max(FeesOutput a, FeesOutput b) {
                            return a.fee() == null ? b : b.fee() == null || a.fee().compareTo(b.fee()) >= 0 ? a : b;
                        }

                        @Override
                        public FeesOutput count(int matches) {
                            return new FeesOutput(java.math.BigDecimal.valueOf(matches));
                        }
                    })
                    .build();
        } catch (java.io.IOException e) {
            throw new java.io.UncheckedIOException(e);
        }
    }
}
